definitions.gloss: old coin; antique coin (especially as a collectible)
definitions.explanation: Coins that are no longer in circulation, or coins from a previous era valued by collectors. Includes pre-modern Japanese coins, foreign coins, and older Japanese yen denominations no longer issued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{古銭|こせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
{古銭|こせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a shop that sells old coins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箪笥|たんす}→箪笥：05012_tansu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{古銭|こせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: Old coins from the Edo period were found in the back of the chest of drawers at my grandmother's house.

examples.japanese: {古銭|こせん}⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}び→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{奥深|おくぶか}い→奥深い：07313_okubukai⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧だ。
examples.english: Coin collecting is a deep hobby in which you can enjoy yourself while learning history.

notes:
{古銭|こせん} literally combines {古|こ} (old) and {銭|せん} (coin, money), forming a noun for old or historical coins. It is the standard term in Japanese for collectible coins, both Japanese and foreign.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古銭|こせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect old coins
- {古銭|こせん}⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧: coin collecting (as a hobby)
- {古銭|こせん}⟦{収集家|しゅうしゅうか}→収集家：16941_shuushuuka⟧: coin collector
- {古銭|こせん}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: coin dealer / coin shop
- {古銭|こせん}⟦{鑑定|かんてい}→鑑定：16030_kantei⟧: coin appraisal
- {寛永|かんえい}{通宝|つうほう}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{古銭|こせん}: old coins such as Kan'ei Tsūhō (a common Edo-period coin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧: coin (general term, includes current coins)
- ⟦コイン→コイン：10852_koin⟧: coin (loanword)
- ⟦{貨幣|かへい}→貨幣：16012_kahei⟧: currency (formal term, including paper money)
- ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧: commemorative coin

DOMAIN: Hobbyist (numismatics), antiques, history. Not commonly used in everyday speech outside collector contexts.
